{{Quote|You're the winner in the log ride contest!|Teebo to Kneesaa|<ref name="Three Cheers for Kneesaa!: An Ewok Adventure">''[[Three Cheers for Kneesaa!: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref>}}
'''Log riding''' was a sport practiced by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]], the [[Bear/Legends|bear]]-like inhabitants of the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]. It was considered a dangerous sport, and, usually, only the older Ewoks performed it. A sporting event known as the Log Ride Contest was organized as part of the Ewok [[midsummer festival]], among several other sporting competitions. On one occasion, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] won the Log Riding Contest after accidentally landed on a [[Tree/Legends|tree]] log going down the river while she was [[vine swinging]].
